purpose: Prospectively test whether a parameter-free Top-3 role-concurrence closure can preserve answer-bearing contract evidence while retaining useful no-evidence abstention on a new expert-annotated legal dataset.

prior_experiment_boundary.known_aggregate_failure_used_only_for_th: v52 exact Top-1 concurrence produced useful abstention but failed against the strongest shared-gate non-FRC control and lost too much evidence F1.

source_access_boundary_at_registration.cuad_repository_content_read: Only public README, train/evaluate code, run command and category-description structure were read; no data.zip member content or example was opened.

official_sources.official_evaluation: evaluate.py uses answer-string Jaccard at least 0.5, with a documented Parties-category substring exception, and reports AUPR plus precision at 80 and 90 percent recall.
official_sources.official_training_command: run.sh trains on data/train_separate_questions.json and evaluates on data/test.json with SQuAD-v2 negative examples.
official_sources.official_model_reference: The official repository links trained RoBERTa-base, RoBERTa-large and DeBERTa-xlarge checkpoints. RoBERTa-base is the only preregistered executable external reference for v53 if its immutable artifact remains available and runtime-compatible.

source_access_order: Freeze this protocol before downloading or opening data.zip.
Download the fixed official repository revision into the ignored CUAD cache, hash every regular source file and data.zip, and list ZIP member names without opening JSON member content.
Implement and synthetically test the reader, candidate construction, blind sampling, Top-3 gate, role closure, shared-gate controls, metrics and deterministic reports before opening train content.
Register protocol, source, implementation, runner and test hashes before opening train content.
Open only train_separate_questions.json to create the development blind cache; do not open test.json.
Register the development sample commitments and CUDA runtime before query generation or neural scoring.
Generate deterministic queries, build the gold-free retrieval pool and score every retained candidate for all development cases before joining train gold.
Join train gold only after the complete development score cache is locked and run the preregistered development gates once.
If and only if every development gate passes, freeze the developed method hash and repeat the same blind sequence once on untouched test.json. Otherwise stop before test content is opened.
Publish positive, negative, null or schema-inconclusive outcomes and forbid reuse of any revealed split for tuning or selection.

development_and_confirmation_scope.sampling: Within answer-bearing and no-answer groups, sort by SHA-256 over the fixed salt, opaque contract commitment and official question id; advance groups in lockstep under the shared per-contract cap.

gold_free_candidate_construction.input: The full given contract context and official question text only.
source_candidates: Every non-empty line after CRLF/CR boundary normalization, split further only when it exceeds 128 whitespace tokens.
Every non-empty punctuation-bounded clause ending in period, semicolon, colon, question mark or exclamation mark, split further only when it exceeds 128 whitespace tokens.
Exact whitespace-token windows of widths 24, 48 and 96 with strides 12, 24 and 48, including the final suffix window.
gold_free_candidate_construction.deduplication: Deduplicate exact start/end offsets, then normalized-whitespace text; choose the earliest start, shortest span and source-kind order line, clause, window_24, window_48, window_96.
gold_free_candidate_construction.retrieval_pool: Union BM25 Top-48 and BGE dense Top-48 over the source candidates; at most 96 unique candidates, ordered by best rank, sum of ranks with missing rank set to candidate count plus one, then canonical candidate id.
gold_free_candidate_construction.post_score_candidate_ceiling: Using the official CUAD string-match rule, every answer-bearing case is complete only if each distinct official answer has at least one candidate match.

deterministic_role_queries.first_fact: Find contract language that directly states the following reviewed clause or term: {question}
deterministic_role_queries.second_fact_or_bridge: Find exceptions, limitations, conditions, scope, dates, parties, amounts, or triggers relevant to the following reviewed clause or term: {question}
deterministic_role_queries.counterevidence: Find contract language that narrows, contradicts, excludes, or makes inapplicable the following reviewed clause or term: {question}

top3_rank_concurrence_gate.per_role_ranking: Sort candidates by descending raw reranker logit for the role, then ascending canonical candidate id.
top3_rank_concurrence_gate.anchor_frontier: The first three anchor-ranked candidates, or all candidates when fewer than three exist.
top3_rank_concurrence_gate.polarity_frontier: The union of the first three first_fact-ranked and first three second_fact_or_bridge-ranked candidates.
top3_rank_concurrence_gate.pass_rule: Pass if and only if the concurrence nucleus is non-empty; otherwise return an empty evidence set.
top3_rank_concurrence_gate.nucleus_order: Ascending max(anchor rank, best polarity rank), then ascending sum(anchor rank, best polarity rank), then canonical candidate id.

role_closure_selector.closure: When the gate passes, take the ordered union of the concurrence nucleus followed by the unchanged v49 selection, remove normalized-text duplicates, then admit in that order while the registered token budget is not exceeded.
role_closure_selector.minimum_nonempty_output_after_gate_pass: If the first nucleus candidate alone exceeds the token budget, emit that single candidate and report the budget overrun; otherwise no overrun is allowed.
role_closure_selector.why_this_tests_frc_specific_value: The shared gate is identical for all gated controls; only the candidate preserves the role-concurrence nucleus and combines it with the FRC low-core selector.

methods.official_cuad_roberta_base: A separately reported executable end-to-end extractive QA reference on official test only. It is trained on CUAD train and is not included in shared-pool FRC support gates or called SetR.

evaluation.answer_bearing_per_case_metric: Set F1 where a selected candidate matches an official answer under CUAD evaluate.py Jaccard at least 0.5; preserve the official Parties-category substring exception.
secondary_metrics: answer-bearing macro precision, recall and F1
mean selected unit and token cost
official CUAD AUPR and precision-at-recall for the official executable reference only

known_scope_limits: CUAD is full-given-contract clause highlighting, not open-corpus retrieval, answer generation or legal advice.
The balanced mechanism sample is not CUAD natural prevalence and is not an official leaderboard submission.

The official RoBERTa-base checkpoint is a real executable reference but uses supervised CUAD training and a different end-to-end extractive QA architecture; it is not a fair same-information FRC selector control.
A positive result would support only the frozen selector under this protocol; it would not reproduce SetR or establish flood-domain expert validity.
